title: renderd service refuses to start: "startup self-test failed"
description_md:
The `renderd` invoice-rendering service won't start. `service renderd start` reports `renderd: startup self-test failed, refusing to start`, and `service renderd status` confirms it isn't running. Nobody touched the service's configuration, and the render helper it depends on internally is exactly where it's always been, with its execute bit clearly set -- `ls -l` shows nothing wrong. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), work out why a script with the execute bit set still won't run when `renderd` tries to invoke it during startup, and get the service running again (you do not have the ability to remount filesystems in this environment -- find a fix that doesn't require it).

You're done when `service renderd start` succeeds and `service renderd status` reports it running.
